spice_of_fabric.meaning: timesEaten = how many of your last 11 eaten items were this same food. Rotate >=11 distinct foods to always eat at full value.

realistic_plant_growth.note: Player-planted crops need natural skylight 15. Torch-lit indoor farms do NOT grow.
realistic_plant_growth.caveat: GrowthRate is % chance a growth tick applies; NaturalDeathChance is % the plant dies on that tick. A crop with no matching biome group and an empty Default biome list does not grow at all.

server_wild_crop_biomes._source: world datapack biome tags with replace:true (these OVERRIDE mod defaults)
server_wild_crop_biomes._insight: Where a crop grows wild on this server is exactly where it farms at 100%. Finding a wild patch identifies the correct farming biome.

pacifist.note: PvP-facing rule set; does not stop you harvesting animals or Pokemon.

villager_trades.note: Vanilla farmer/butcher/fisherman trades are unchanged and remain the fastest emerald->food conversion.

forced_gamerules.consequence: You NEVER heal from a full hunger bar. Health only returns via regeneration/instant_health effects, absorption, or potions. This also means hunger drains far slower than vanilla, because the 6.0-exhaustion-per-heal drain never fires.

kelp.note: dried kelp has a 10% chance to poison; do not use it as a staple

treecapitator.note: whole-tree felling; wood gathering is cheap, so tool crafting is cheap

storm_lightning.note: CORRECTED: targets players flying (elytra / flying Pokemon). Risk starts 8 blocks above the ground, full damage at 48. A player on foot has clearance ~0 and is never struck.
storm_lightning.measures: clearanceBelow — empty air UNDER the player, i.e. height above ground

zymlabs_server_rules.golem_truce: Iron golems can be appeased per-player (GolemTruce.APPEASED attachment); village access is reputation-gated.
zymlabs_server_rules.lootr_lock: Some Lootr chests are access-gated by the server rule set.

consequences: Cannot sleep through the night — no skipping to morning.
Mobs are forced to spawn on the surface, including on top of your farm.
pacifist-fabric suspends pacifism during both events, so PvP is live.

Harvest and blue moons are opportunities: sleeping skips the night, and with it the bonus.

Blue moon: the night to enchant and repair (costs halved; quartered on a super blue moon).

tools_and_harvest._verified_against: wild-crop loot tables in every content mod
tools_and_harvest.hoe_effect_on_drops: NONE. No wild-crop or crop loot table in this pack is conditioned on a hoe.

what_actually_changes_drops.shears: The only tool predicate on wild crops. Shears yield the PLANT BLOCK itself (for transplanting) INSTEAD of the food/seeds.
what_actually_changes_drops.fortune: Enchantment, not tool tier. Applies to seed/secondary drops via apply_bonus (FD: uniform_bonus_count bonusMultiplier 2; Let's Do: 12% base scaled by level). A hoe can carry Fortune, but a plain wooden hoe does nothing.

tools_and_harvest.why_you_still_need_a_hoe: Tilling farmland. Without a hoe you cannot create farmland and cannot plant anything. Realistic Plant Growth sets require_hoe:false for players, so harvesting needs no hoe — only planting does.

hoe_cost.hunger_cost: Tilling adds no exhaustion in vanilla (only block BREAKING does, at 0.005 each). The hunger cost of getting a hoe is the walking and log-breaking, not the tilling.
hoe_cost.note: zymlabs Treecapitator fells whole trees at 1 durability per log, so wood for tools is very cheap here.

pacifism._source: pacifist-fabric-1.1.0 (MobMixin, TargetingConditionsMixin, GrudgeGroups, AlwaysHostileMobs, LunarEvents, Villages) + config/pacifist-fabric.json

grudge_groups.rule: Provoking ONE member turns the whole kin group hostile to you. Never melee a zombie in a group unless you intend to fight all zombie-kin nearby.

always_hostile.mechanism: AlwaysHostileMobs accepts supplied exemptions at runtime; config villageAlwaysIgnores=[minecraft:creeper]

pacifism.bot_consequence: Night travel is SAFE by default. The bot's threat model is not 'mobs at night' but 'do not provoke, and do not be in a village at night or out during a blood moon'.

bed_and_rest._why_it_matters: naturalRegeneration is OFF. Bed rest is the primary renewable heal, and it is PAID FOR IN HUNGER. This is the direct link between the farming economy and the health economy.
rules: Resting heals 1 HP per 900-tick (45s) cycle, up to 5 HP per day.
Each HP healed costs 1 hunger point.
Rest requires WARMTH: a heat source within radius 4, height 2 of the bed.
Beds are CLAIMED per player (BedClaims.OWNED_BED). One owned bed each; a bot needs its own.
A TOWN is >=3 beds clustered within 64 blocks. This is why 3+ players is a mechanical minimum, not a suggestion.
bed_and_rest.bot_consequence: Healing 5 HP costs 5 hunger, i.e. roughly one good meal. Bed placement priority should be weighed as: expected_damage_taken * hunger_per_hp vs. cost of walking home. Far from spawn, the downside of death (full item loss to a grave) dominates, so bed priority should rise with distance from the current spawn point.

mechanics: Death drops your items into a grave block at the death site, not scattered.
You respawn at your spawn point (bed if claimed and valid, else world spawn) with nothing.
civfabric has a 'dbno' (down-but-not-out) module — downed state before true death.
Experience is NOT fully kept by the grave.
death_and_graves.bot_consequence: Death cost = full trip back to the grave + lost time, not lost items. So the dominant risk metric is DISTANCE FROM SPAWN, exactly as the design intends.

lunar_forecast.base_command: Enhanced Celestials also registers /lunarForecast (world data, same answer for everyone). civfabric's version is the per-player noisy one.
lunar_forecast.seeded_by: seed(player UUID, day bucket) — each player gets an INDEPENDENT reading of the same underlying truth

reading.confidence: double, displayed as percent with one decimal

accuracy_by_class_rank.rank_source: max rank across SpecConfig.FORECAST_CLASSES via ClassManager.rank(player, classType)
accuracy_by_class_rank.meaning: sensitivity = P(reports E | E is true). noise = P(reports E | E is false).

lunar_forecast.note_on_active_events: The EC jar ships 7 event types, but the world datapack only defines blood_moon and super_blood_moon. legalOn(time) filters by moon phase, so super_blood_moon can only be reported on a full moon (phase 0).

fusion_math.why: Because readings are independently seeded per player and share one prior, they are conditionally independent observations of the same truth. Log-odds fusion is exact, not an approximation.
fusion_math.with_rank_known: odds = prior_odds * PROD_i LR_i, where LR_i = sens_i/noise_i if player i reports E, else (1-sens_i)/(1-noise_i).
fusion_math.with_only_confidence_known: combined_odds = prior_odds * PROD_i (odds_i / prior_odds), where odds_i = c_i/(1-c_i). This needs no rank, only each reported confidence and the shared prior.
fusion_math.worked_example: Three rank-0 players (sens 0.4, noise 0.1) all report blood_moon on a non-full-moon night. prior 0.0522 -> odds 0.0551. LR = 4.0 each. Fused odds = 0.0551*64 = 3.53 -> P = 0.78. One rank-0 reading alone would be only P = 0.18.

forecast_classes._source: user (server owner knowledge); SpecConfig.FORECAST_CLASSES is server-config driven
forecast_classes.caveat: Only these two are known to contribute. rank(player) = MAX rank across the ACTIVE forecast classes.
forecast_classes._critical: HUNTER is DISABLED by default (ClassSetup.DEFAULT_ENABLED excludes it). So on current settings LIBRARIAN is the ONLY live forecast class, and a player's forecast rank == their LIBRARIAN rank.
forecast_classes.when_hunter_returns: Owner intends to enable HUNTER and raise specialisationSlots to 3. Forecast rank then = max(LIBRARIAN, HUNTER), so two classes can carry it and readings get cheaper to source.

fusion_reference_table._group: 3 players; with HUNTER off only a LIBRARIAN has rank > 0
_key_findings: A high-rank LIBRARIAN's SILENCE is close to a veto: LIB5 silent + two rank-0 positives = 0.082.
Three rank-0 readings (0.779) just beat one LIB5 alone (0.713) — pooling novices works for DETECTION.
But for an ALL-CLEAR the librarian is irreplaceable: nobody-reports is 0.002 with a LIB5 present vs 0.016 without. 8x more certain.
So LIBRARIAN rank buys confident NEGATIVES more than confident positives. Positives can be crowdsourced; negatives cannot.

forecast_guess.how: Name the moon you expect (or a quiet night) and a class to receive the reward. If it comes true you earn class XP; you can change your guess until the night.
forecast_guess.bot_relevance: A bot running the P2P fusion has the best estimate in the group, so it can guess nightly and bank reliable class XP into a class of its choice.
forecast_guess.wrong_guess_penalty: none — a miss only prints 'The ... did not come.' Verified in settle(); owner confirms it's deliberate (to discourage gambling).
forecast_guess.reward_formula: clamp(160 * x, 0, 160); x = 1 - own_reading_confidence if the guess matches your own /lunarforecast moon, else own_reading_confidence
forecast_guess.reward_formula_consequence: Agreeing with a confident reading pays little; a correct contrarian guess pays a lot. Team readings that contradict your own are worth XP.
forecast_guess.guessable_note: super_* moons count as their base moon (categoryOf strips 'super_'). Blue and harvest moons are ON on the live server (owner, 2026-09-22).
forecast_guess.xp_award: ClassManager.awardUnboosted — no under-attack or pacifism multipliers
forecast_guess.timing: guess before tick 13000 targets tonight, after it targets tomorrow night; changeable until then
forecast_guess.bot_strategy: always guess (free); pick argmax over g of P_own(g) * reward(g)
